description: It is in most ways a somber anniversary, remembering one of those days where you felt like you literally couldn't believe your eyes. By September 2001, I had been in the Navy for 15 years. During that time, we had had the first Gulf War, and a good number of smaller military actions around the world, but we could be forgiven for thinking that the world was getting more peaceful. George Bush had run on Compassionate Conservatism, the Soviet Union was no more, and China was still a rising power
